policy_requirement: Current NASDAQ account value/exposure must be known for TRUE FULL GO; unresolved account state caps final status but must not suppress a valid research candidate.
pass_rule: A sanctioned connected broker adapter must, in the same run, return parseable current account value/cash state and current equity positions/exposure. Empty positions are valid known exposure. Permission/auth/tool errors are never PASS.
persistence_rule: Never persist balances, positions, account identifiers, buying power, or other private account values to the public repository; persist status/provenance only.

LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.security_model: Use least-privilege market-data + account authorization only. Never request/persist App Secret, Access Token, auth code, balances, positions, or account identifiers in chat/public repo.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.canonical_gate_rule: Technical path is sufficient in shape but ACCOUNT remains blocked until the canonical scheduler itself can securely hold/redeem the account-scoped OAuth credential and perform same-run account_balance + stock_positions.
evidence: Official Longbridge OpenAPI exposes GET /v1/asset/account via TradeContext.account_balance and GET /v1/asset/stock via TradeContext.stock_positions.
Official CLI/docs state account/portfolio reads require OAuth account permission; account scope is selectable separately from trading scope and least-privilege authorization is recommended.
Agent Auth Code can carry only the scopes explicitly selected on Longbridge Connect, including account without requiring trading scope.
OpenAPI activation/API use is available through Longbridge's official developer platform; credentials/tokens must stay outside repository and chat.
Current ChatGPT Longbridge connector exposes account_balance/stock_positions but no authenticate/Agent-Auth-Code redemption surface; its active OAuth token still returns 403308 on account reads.
ChatGPT plugin-management surface in this workspace cannot modify Longbridge OAuth/admin scopes, and no separate installable Longbridge plugin was surfaced.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.reopen_condition: A supported canonical runtime exposes Longbridge OAuth account-scope authorization/redeem securely; then run same-run read-only account_balance + stock_positions with no order endpoints.

transition_to_pass: Only fresh same-run provider readback satisfying the pass_rule may set ACCOUNT=PASS. Persisted prior PASS alone is insufficient.
